observations: Photos show a full-size electronic keyboard on grass.
Brand name “YAMAHA” is visible on the keyboard body (photo 0 and photo 2).
There are many control buttons/sliders and a large panel, suggesting a feature-rich keyboard (not a small toy).
No clear model number is readable from the photos provided.
No photo shows power-on, screen display, speakers, or audio output.

claims.claim: Quality and good Yamaha keyboard for children
claims.evidence: Photos show a Yamaha keyboard, but there is no proof of condition, sound, or suitability for children (no power-on/audio/controls test).

risks.risk: Exact Yamaha model is not readable, so the price could be wrong (different models vary a lot in value).
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the model name/number label (usually on the back panel or near the control area) and/or the full front panel text.
risks.if_unproven: Price it as a generic Yamaha electronic keyboard with unknown model and assume average condition.

risks.risk: Functionality is unknown (keys, speakers, power, and buttons may be faulty).
risks.proof: A short video of power-on plus playing a few notes and demonstrating at least one feature (e.g., rhythm/voice) with volume audible.
risks.if_unproven: Price it as not fully tested/possibly needing repair.

risks.risk: Missing accessories (power adapter, stand, sustain pedal, manual) can reduce value.
risks.proof: Photos showing everything included: power adapter/charger, any pedals, and what the seller says is included.
risks.if_unproven: Price it assuming only the keyboard is included (no accessories).

risks.risk: Cosmetic wear/damage is not fully assessable from these angles (scratches, broken keys, worn buttons).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the keybed (especially around the middle keys), control buttons, and both ends of the keyboard.
risks.if_unproven: Price it as average used condition.

proof_requests: Clear close-up of the model number/label (back or side) so the exact Yamaha model can be identified.
Video: power-on + working keys (play a scale) + audible sound from speakers.
Show what accessories are included (power adapter/charger, sustain pedal, stand if any).
Close-ups of any worn/broken areas: keys (front), control panel buttons/sliders, and both ends.
response.reason: The photos confirm it is a Yamaha electronic keyboard, but the exact model and working condition (power/audio/buttons) are not verifiable remotely, so a reliable worst-case price can’t be set yet.
